captions.detailed: A snowmobile front suspension assembly consisting of a large black rectangular chassis mounting block, a dark grey A-arm wishbone frame, a vertical steering kingpin, and a lower grey ski mounting saddle. The A-arm is pivoted at the chassis block with dual cylindrical mounts on a horizontal axis, allowing vertical swing. At the outer end of the A-arm, a vertical cylindrical spindle serves as a steering king-post, allowing the ski mounting saddle at the bottom to rotate horizontally.
captions.instruction: Design an articulated snowmobile front suspension spindle assembly using CadQuery. The model should feature a chassis mounting block, a pivoting A-arm wishbone, a vertical steering kingpin, and a lower ski mounting saddle, with revolute joints connecting the chassis to the A-arm and the A-arm to the steering spindle.
captions.factory: Construct the chassis mount using a combination of box primitives representing the main block. Create the A-arm by combining cylindrical tubes into a wishbone shape, terminating in pivot collars modeled with cylinders. Build the steering spindle using a vertical cylinder for the kingpin, supported by vertical plates. Construct the ski saddle at the base using extruded U-channel blocks and plates, then define revolute joint articulations between the chassis and A-arm, and between the A-arm and the steering spindle.
